findings.title: Populate verified printed-page metadata for 字源 pages 613–614
findings.details: The current source-page metadata lists `printed_page: null` for PDF pages 613 and 614, while scan-verified evidence identifies them as printed pages 600 and 601. The source metadata therefore omits verified page locators needed for citation and audit.
findings.verification: Add source-bound printed-page metadata for PDF pages 613 and 614, validate it against the supplied scans, and confirm regenerated locators expose printed pages 600 and 601 without changing the source images or OCR.
evidence: current_source_page_metadata: page 613 and 614 have printed_page null
